story.iWant: to create and manage notification rules
story.soThat: I only receive alerts for content I care about
story.tasks: 1. Create Notifications settings page/modal, 2. Implement rule creation form fields, 3. Add notification channel selection, 4. Implement quiet hours configuration, 5. Add rule testing functionality, 6. Implement rule persistence and activation, 7. Create rules management list, 8. Create comprehensive test suite for UI components

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given I open the Notifications settings, When I click "Create Alert Rule", Then I can define: rule name, domains, sources, keywords, categories 2. And I can choose notification channels (browser, email) 3. And I can set quiet hours (no notifications during specified times) 4. And I can test the rule against recent content 5. When I save the rule, Then it becomes active immediately 6. And I see a list of all my rules with edit/delete options
